USE WAREHOUSE team_f_wh;
WITH base AS (
  SELECT CATEGORY_LEVEL_1,
         COUNT(*) AS denom,
         SUM(CASE WHEN GENDER_NAME = '男性' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numer
  FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2
  WHERE CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 IS NOT NULL AND GENDER_NAME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY CATEGORY_LEVEL_1
),
with_pct AS (
  SELECT *, ROUND(100.0 * numer / denom, 2) AS pct
  FROM base WHERE denom >= 1000
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS valid_questions,
       MIN(pct) AS min_pct, MAX(pct) AS max_pct, ROUND(AVG(pct),2) AS avg_pct
FROM with_pct WHERE pct BETWEEN 5 AND 95
